name: CortexMind v4.1.1
body:
## CortexMind 4.1.1

**See it start.** While CortexMind starts up, its menu bar icon now pulses and the menu shows what it is doing: downloading models (with a percentage), loading, warming up. On macOS the progress also appears right next to the icon. It switches to Running the moment your memory is ready.

**Always up to date.** The menu bar now keeps watching after startup too, so it shows the real state at all times.

**Clearer sign-in.** When ChatGPT or Claude asks you to sign in to CortexMind, the page now asks for your "CortexMind Password", the same name the app uses in Settings.

**A guide for ChatGPT and Claude.** Settings now links to a step-by-step page for connecting ChatGPT and Claude on the web, on your phone and in their desktop apps.

Full changelog: https://cortexmind.net/changelog

Signed updater artifacts are attached. Existing installs update automatically.

name: CortexMind v4.1.0
body:
## CortexMind 4.1.0

**AI instructions that fit ChatGPT.** The memory instructions in Settings are now about half as long, so they paste straight into ChatGPT's custom instructions with room to spare for your own.

**En français aussi.** The AI instructions now come in English and French. Pick the language right above the Copy button; CortexMind remembers your choice and defaults to your system language.

**Clearer next steps.** Under the instructions, the app now tells you where to paste them and how to check they work: open a new chat and ask "What do you know about me?"

Full changelog: https://cortexmind.net/changelog

Signed updater artifacts are attached. Existing installs update automatically.

name: CortexMind v4.0.0
body:
## CortexMind 4.0.0

**GPU acceleration everywhere.** Memory search now runs on the GPU on every platform: Metal on Apple Silicon, and any Vulkan-capable card on Linux and Windows, including NVIDIA, AMD and Intel Arc. Nothing extra to download: the inference engine ships inside the app.

**Picks the right device on its own.** On first launch CortexMind times your CPU against every GPU it can see and keeps the fastest. A GPU that would be slower than your CPU is never used. `memory_status` shows exactly which device each model is running on.

**Lighter on your machine.** About 2 GB of GPU memory when a GPU is in use, the reranker runs at full precision, and the first launch after upgrading removes the old model files, freeing several gigabytes of disk.

**Faster on Apple Silicon.** Memory search on an M-series Mac is roughly twice as fast as in 3.8.

Full changelog: https://cortexmind.net/changelog

Signed updater artifacts are attached. Existing installs update automatically.
